# `pmod`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
pmod(expr1, expr2)
```

Returns the positive value of `expr1` mod `expr2`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- pmod, example 1
> SELECT pmod(10, 3);
1
```

```sql
-- pmod, example 2
> SELECT pmod(-10, 3);
2
```
